# ShrotiHost

> One technology partner from first domain to production: web hosting (shared, WordPress, unlimited, reseller), domain registration, and software development (websites, mobile apps, e-commerce, SaaS, custom software) for students, developers, startups, and businesses in India. Free SSL, LiteSpeed, NVMe storage, daily backups, free migration, and renewal prices that match day-one prices.

## Hosting plans

- [Shared Hosting](https://shrotihost.in/hosting): Bronze, Gold, Platinum, and Diamond plans on LiteSpeed and NVMe storage, from entry-level to 10+ websites.
- [WordPress Hosting](https://shrotihost.in/wordpress-hosting): Hosting tuned for WordPress and WooCommerce with LiteSpeed caching.
- [Unlimited Hosting](https://shrotihost.in/unlimited-hosting): One plan covering as many sites as you run.
- [Reseller Hosting](https://shrotihost.in/reseller-hosting): White-label hosting business starter with WHM and cPanel accounts.
- [Master Reseller Hosting](https://shrotihost.in/master-reseller-hosting): Create and manage resellers of your own.
- [Alpha Reseller Hosting](https://shrotihost.in/alpha-reseller-hosting): Top reseller tier with maximum resources.
- [VPS Hosting](https://shrotihost.in/vps): Coming soon.

## Domains

- [Domain Search & Registration](https://shrotihost.in/domains): Search, compare extensions, and register with upfront register and renewal pricing for every TLD sold.

## Development services

- [Web Development](https://shrotihost.in/web-development): Business websites, landing pages, web applications, dashboards, and custom systems — designed, built, and hosted by one team.
- [App Development](https://shrotihost.in/app-development): Android, iOS, and cross-platform mobile apps with backend, APIs, authentication, and deployment.
- [E-commerce Development](https://shrotihost.in/ecommerce-development): WooCommerce stores and custom storefronts with payments and shipping, on hosting tuned for the workload.
- [SaaS Development](https://shrotihost.in/saas-development): MVPs and full SaaS products with accounts, subscription billing, and dashboards.
- [Custom Software](https://shrotihost.in/custom-software): Internal tools, automation, integrations, and WHMCS modules.
- [Portfolio](https://shrotihost.in/portfolio): Real products ShrotiHost builds and runs — no stock case studies.

## Products

- [WHMCS Gateway Fees & Allocator Module](https://shrotihost.in/whmcs-gateway-fees-allocator): WHMCS module that adds gateway fees and allocates payments automatically.
- [WHMCS WhatsApp Notification Module](https://shrotihost.in/whmcs-whatsapp-notification-module): WHMCS module that sends client notifications over WhatsApp.
